sql: with f as (select split_part(f.market_ticker,'-',1) as series, f.market_ticker from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy ilike '%%mmsell%%'), s as (select series, count(distinct market_ticker) as live_markets, count(*) as fills from f group by 1), t as (select sum(live_markets) as total from s) select series, live_markets, fills, round(100.0*sum(live_markets) over (order by live_markets desc, series rows unbounded preceding)/t.total,1) as cum_pct, row_number() over (order by live_markets desc, series) as rank from s, t order by live_markets desc, series limit 80
